The walls are seen as vertical side strips, and the left wall's inner edge is a dark outline that steps inward toward the bottom. The ramp has no south-facing front face. Its lower end at rows 62-63 only has a thin dark line under the walls and then runs straight into flat sand ground at rows 64-79. The ramp plane is the only large horizontal-ish surface and has no front-edge line or eave shadow. With no front face of 3 or more rows, it reads as a flat top-down slab with side walls rather than a three-quarter block.
